knownLimits: No new browser run, screenshot, computed style, runtime/AT result or adoption exists in this preparation.
Border-based endpoint silhouettes illustrate geometry/reading intent only; they do not execute or reproduce the approved shared conic/mask engine, smoothing or fractional arcs.
The 10% opacity applies only to static empty-track silhouettes, never to a whole group or reading row. Actual runtime arc alpha remains the existing token/CVA definition.
Static semantics and fixture IDs do not verify unique useId relationships, validation, rerender independence or unavailable recovery.
Existing historical visual approvals are scoped; supplementary PREP captures do not silently replace VIS-01/02 or grant private-refactor/recipe permissions.
Center content is decorative and consumer-constrained. No fit/scaling guarantee is inferred for arbitrary content in the 16px smallest hole.
Parent supplies compiled tokens/fonts and capture tooling; no dependency installation, token mutation, production renderer or server is included.
Later runtime must verify -1/0/42.5/100/101, NaN and both infinities independently; endpoint illustrations cannot prove decimal/clamp/non-finite behavior.
